import json
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(c for r in g for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(c not in (bg,) and r.count(c)<len(r) for c in r)]
    # shape color: non-bg cells
    shape_rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) for c in r if c!=bg and (r.count(c)!=len(r))]
    if not shape_rows: return out
    bottom=max(shape_rows)
    sc=None
    for r in g:
        for c in r:
            if c!=bg and c not in [x for x in set(r) if r.count(x)==len(r)]:
                sc=c
    # simpler: shape color = the non-bg color that isn't a full row
    fullcols=set()
    for r in g:
        for c in set(r):
            if c!=bg and r.count(c)==len(r): fullcols.add(c)
    for r in g:
        for c in r:
            if c!=bg and c not in fullcols: sc=c
    out[bottom+1]=[sc]*len(g[0])
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find 2 line orientation
    horiz=None
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        if r.count(2)==w and w>1: horiz=True; pos=i
    for j in range(w):
        if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(h)) and h>1: horiz=False; pos=j
    # find shape cells (non-bg, non-2, non-line)
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(c for r in g for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,2,8)]
    col=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg
    if horiz:
        rows=[i for i,j in cells]; top,bot=min(rows),max(rows)
        if top-1==pos:  # touching above line
            newtop,newbot=top,bot
        elif bot+1==pos:  # line below
            newtop,newbot=top,bot
        elif top>pos:  # shape below line, move up to pos+1
            d=top-(pos+1); newtop,newbot=top-d,bot-d
        else:
            d=(pos-1)-bot; newtop,newbot=top+d,bot+d
        for i,j in cells: out[i-d if top>pos else i+d][j]=col
        # 8 line adjacent away from line
        line8 = newbot+1 if newtop>pos else newtop-1
        out[line8]=[8]*w
    else:
        cols=[j for i,j in cells]; left,right=min(cols),max(cols)
        if left-1==pos or right+1==pos:
            nl,nr=left,right; d=0
        elif left>pos:
            d=left-(pos+1); nl,nr=left-d,right-d
        else:
            d=(pos-1)-right; nl,nr=left+d,right+d
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j+d]=col
        line8 = nr+1 if nl>pos else nl-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][line8]=8
    return out
